name: Severe Flooding at the Harbor

npcs.name: Mang Lito
dialogue: The flash flood and typhoon have left the harbor water rising. The lower road is underwater.
Use the marked high route and do not enter the current to reach the warehouse.
after_dialogue: We are on high ground. Keep away from damaged docks and any water near power lines.
rescue_dialogue: I am stranded and need the drinking water. Please bring it, then help me get to the marked high ground, away from floodwater.
rescue_success_dialogue: Thank you. I can follow you to the marked high ground, away from floodwater now.
npcs.rescue_hint: Find the drinking water, then speak with Mang Lito again.

choice.prompt: The lower harbor is submerged. Which rescue plan?

options.text: Use confirmed high routes and call responders
options.result: The team uses accessible high routes.
options.consequence: You followed the confirmed evacuation route.
options.mascot: Following official warnings and protecting people is the safer choice.

options.text: Enter the current to reach the warehouse
options.result: Strong currents and unseen hazards make entry unsafe.
options.mascot: Taking a shortcut through a hazard can injure people and damage resources.

quests.title: Find a first-aid kit for the evacuation to high ground.

mascot.intro: I'm Tarsi! Move with WASD or arrows. E: talk, Q: ability, H: hint, P: pause. Finish your tasks and reach safety.

quests.community: Find Mang Lito and press E.
quests.evacuate: Reach High Ground / School and stay clear of danger.

lessons: Never walk or drive through floodwater; depth and current can be hard to judge.
Move to higher ground and follow local evacuation instructions.
Keep emergency supplies and a family communication plan ready.

quiz.question: Floodwater covers your planned route. What should you do?
options: Turn around and use a safe route directed by local authorities
Walk through if it looks shallow
Follow a vehicle through the water
quiz.explanation: Floodwater depth and current are difficult to judge. Never walk or drive through it.

briefing: Storm rain and coastal water overwhelm the low district. Rescue residents from safe access points, identify routes that remain above water, and prioritize essential supplies. Recover the transmission from the control station.
story_clue: The transmission links the signals to a remote facility in the North East Plains.
